note: Triples are [optimist, methodologist, skeptic]. LLM scores are NOT objective measurements; same model played all roles.

novelty.why: Oracle headroom analysis is standard; unmeasured for tool-call chains (E7 probes once)

feasibility.why: Offline deterministic tools, local 4-8B model; branching cost bounded

impact.why: Decides whether P1 exists; a null result is still informative

testability.why: Pre-registered threshold, held-out evaluation, permutation null

clarity.why: Clear definitions of oracle, split-half filter and stop rule

distinctiveness.why: Measurement role differs from estimator ideas

novelty.why: Off-policy doubly-robust counterfactual labels not in matrix; E11 runs both arms

feasibility.why: Needs propensity logging and DR estimator; small data risks high variance

impact.why: Label cost is the practical barrier for any step-level estimator

testability.why: Equal-rollout comparison with eps=0 control can fail

clarity.why: DR estimator needs careful write-up for implementers

distinctiveness.why: Distinct: changes label source, not estimator

novelty.why: Hidden-state probe after a draft vs FLARE token-probability anticipation (E21)

feasibility.why: Draft generation and cached states; extra decoding cost to charge

impact.why: Could change when decisions are made; break-even claim is useful

testability.why: AUROC gap and break-even cost ratio both measurable

distinctiveness.why: Only idea changing probe input timing

novelty.why: Flip-level analysis of tool necessity absent from matrix

feasibility.why: Needs C01 labels first; flips may be rare so detector data-starved

impact.why: Explains where headroom lives; informs features for MUP

testability.why: Flip rate >= 15% and AUROC gap falsifiable

clarity.why: Flip definition depends on lambda; needs care

distinctiveness.why: Target variable is new; overlaps C01 labels

novelty.why: Two-head utility probe resembles LNE/LUE (E12) at step level

feasibility.why: Linear heads on cached hidden states, seconds to train (E34)

impact.why: Core estimator for P1; value depends on E12 weakness being fixable

testability.why: Head-to-head vs need-probe on identical data

distinctiveness.why: Overlaps G1a/G1c as shared estimator family

novelty.why: Protocol contribution; cumulative-cost metrics are an extension of E1

impact.why: Prevents invalid comparisons; supports all other ideas

testability.why: Rank-reversal Kendall tau test can fail

novelty.why: Ensemble uncertainty for decisions is generic; step-level regret use is modest

impact.why: Helps under noisy labels; limited standalone impact

novelty.why: Per-query p_tool plus confidently-wrong correction vs CTA global p_ret (E16)

feasibility.why: Query encoder + logistic; needs tool-run labels; E12 caution

impact.why: Targets author-stated black-box limitation G2 and CTA's open prior-estimation problem

testability.why: U-AUC vs CTA rule on 3 scenarios, net of signal cost

novelty.why: Benefit-ranked risk-controlled skipping not found; conformal tools exist (E30)

feasibility.why: Learn-then-Test calibration is cheap; needs a benefit estimator

impact.why: Gives a guarantee-style claim users can act on

testability.why: Risk guarantee and savings both measurable over random splits

distinctiveness.why: Guarantee focus is unlike other P2 ideas

novelty.why: Sequential sampling for call decisions not found; classical SPRT idea

feasibility.why: Sampling API only; works with any black box

impact.why: Cuts signal cost (G5); bounded by how often queries stop early

testability.why: Samples per query and net U measured directly

novelty.why: Gating of a two-sided estimator is largely engineering

feasibility.why: Needs tuning of gate thresholds jointly

impact.why: Reduces estimator consultation; value hinges on G1b

testability.why: Gate rate and U within 1 point are checkable

clarity.why: Two-stage rule clear but thresholds fiddly

distinctiveness.why: Near-duplicate of G1b and the eliminated G1c

novelty.why: Cheap-preview value-of-information for tool benefit not found

feasibility.why: Preview differs per tool; implementable for retrieval only at first

impact.why: Gains likely limited to retrieval scenario

testability.why: AUROC gain and net U after preview cost

clarity.why: Per-tool interface needs a clear spec

novelty.why: Few-shot recalibration under shift is standard calibration practice

testability.why: Fraction of lost U recovered is measurable

distinctiveness.why: Calibration under shift is a separate axis
